Conference Name: 20th Vaccine Congress
Program/Agenda: Invited plenary lectures, contributed talks and poster sessions on the latest research in vaccine science. The programme is curated by a committee of academic leaders in their respective fields. Posters can be submitted by 30 August 2026.
Keynote Speakers: Ivan Hung (The University of Hong Kong, China), Florian Krammer (Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, USA), Angela Rasmussen (University of Saskatchewan, Canada)

Conference Name: 4th NIZO Plant Protein Functionality Conference
Program/Agenda: Brings together the latest scientific and technological advances in protein functionality, with a focus on plant-based and fermentation-derived proteins. The programme covers protein functionality across diverse biological sources, linking protein chemistry, processing, physics, formulation, sensory science, nutrition and sustainability.
Technical/Program Committee: Organising Committee: Steven Cornet (NIZO), Joanna Folan (Elsevier), Celine Brattinga (NIZO), Fred van de Velde (NIZO)

Conference Name: Food Structure & Functionality Symposium
Venue: Palazzo Regionale dei Congressi, Grado, Italy
Program/Agenda: Food materials science as the foundation of next-generation food design, uniting scientists and industry leaders to explore how structure, processing and formulation can be tuned to create desirable functionality and eating quality. Abstract submission deadline 8 May 2026; author notification 26 June 2026; author registration deadline 24 July 2026.

Conference Name: 2nd Global Cleaner Production Conference
Program/Agenda: Plenary sessions, interactive workshops and editorial panel discussions. Authors attending are invited to submit their papers for consideration in the Journal of Cleaner Production.

Conference Name: GeoGulf 2027
Program/Agenda: The 76th GCAGS/GCSSEPM Convention and Exposition, hosted by the Houston Geological Society. The convention features oral and poster presentations, field trips and networking events. Open-call abstract submission deadline 1 December 2026.

Conference Name: IFT FIRST 2027
Venue: McCormick Place, Chicago, Illinois, United States
Program/Agenda: Educational sessions, workshops, live demonstrations and panel discussions on food science and technology. For the first time all scientific programming takes place directly in the expo hall.

Conference Name: RSNA Annual Meeting 2027
Venue: McCormick Place, Chicago, Illinois, United States
Program/Agenda: The 113th Scientific Assembly and Annual Meeting of the Radiological Society of North America, running Sunday to Thursday. Technical Exhibits run Sunday to Wednesday and close on 17 November.

Conference Name: Cell Press Symposia: Hallmarks of Aging
Program/Agenda: Explores the most recent advances in the molecular and cellular hallmarks of aging and how they influence aging and disease at the organ, tissue and organismal level, from metabolism and disease to gerotechnology and gerotherapeutics. Abstract submissions are due by 5 June 2026.
Keynote Speakers: Keynote Speaker: Luigi Ferrucci (National Institute on Aging)
Technical/Program Committee: Organizers: Rafael de Cabo (National Institute on Aging), Ana Maria Cuervo (Albert Einstein College of Medicine)
Pricing/Registration: Registration EUR 490 to 965, depending on registration time and student status

Conference Name: Cell Symposia: Taking Programmed Cell Death from Mechanisms to Interventions
Program/Agenda: Held in partnership with Zhejiang University and Liangzhu Laboratory. Covers inflammatory and non-inflammatory cell death processes including pyroptosis, ferroptosis, necroptosis and apoptosis, and how they control the balance of health and disease as well as fundamental processes such as growth and development.
Keynote Speakers: Douglas Green (St. Jude Children's Research Hospital)
Technical/Program Committee: Organizers: Francis Chan (Liangzhu Laboratory Zhejiang University), Eicke Latz (German Rheumatology Research Center DRFZ)

Conference Name: Cell Press Symposia: Biological Function in 3D — Structure, Dynamics, and AI
Venue: Southern University of Science and Technology, 1088 Xueyuan Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, China
Program/Agenda: Held in partnership with the Southern University of Science and Technology. Supporting Cell Press publications are Structure, Cell and Molecular Cell.

Conference Name: Cell Press Symposia: Drugging the Undruggable
Program/Agenda: Addresses how certain molecules and biological pathways have long been considered undruggable, and the challenges that presents in therapeutic development.

Conference Name: Cell Press Symposia: Functional RNAs
Program/Agenda: Held in partnership with the University of Geneva and the Swiss Initiative for RNA and Disease. The meeting covers the full spectrum of RNA biology, spanning fundamental mechanisms, structural biology, RNA therapeutics, discovery tools and computational strategies. Abstract submission deadline 18 June 2027; early registration deadline 9 July 2027.

Conference Name: EPIDEMICS 11: 11th International Conference on Infectious Disease Dynamics
Program/Agenda: Regularly attracts over 500 scientists, with representatives from many of the major research groups in this area worldwide, for dialogue on the latest ideas, data, insight, models and methods in infectious disease dynamics. Abstracts for talks and posters are invited by 18 June 2027; Scientific Committee decisions are expected by 28 July 2027; author registration and early booking deadline 17 September 2027.

Conference Name: Future Foods Congress 2027
Venue: Kyoto International Conference Center, Kyoto, Japan
Program/Agenda: Held under the theme Shaping Future Food Systems through Sustainability and Digital Innovation. The programme includes invited plenary keynote lectures, parallel oral presentation sessions and poster presentations, covering alternative proteins, plant-based foods, cultivated meat and cellular agriculture, precision fermentation and novel ingredients.

Conference Name: Global Emergency Nursing Conference 2027
Venue: Postillion Convention Centre WTC Rotterdam, Rotterdam, Netherlands
Program/Agenda: Presented by the Emergency Nurses Association and Elsevier. The programme includes keynote and plenary sessions, podium and poster presentations on emergency care challenges and the practices in use to support patients around the globe. Abstracts are invited for oral and poster presentations with a deadline of 7 May 2027; author notification 30 June 2027; author registration and early bird deadline 16 July 2027.

Conference Name: Desalination Science and Technology 2027
Program/Agenda: The 8th International Conference on Desalination Science and Technology, a forum bridging laboratory-scale discoveries with industry-scale desalination applications. The programme features plenary lectures, keynote speeches, oral presentations and interactive poster sessions, with emphasis on novel desalination materials, innovative hybrid systems and advanced module design, alongside pre-treatment and post-treatment processes and membrane fouling and control. Awards are presented for the best oral and poster contributions from students and early-career researchers.

Conference Name: 5th International Conference on Bioresource Technology for Bioenergy, Bioproducts & Environmental Sustainability
Venue: Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Program/Agenda: A forum to highlight scientific breakthroughs, share practical case studies and identify opportunities for collaboration that can accelerate translation from research to real-world impact, bringing together researchers in academia and industry as well as policymakers to discuss the latest trends in biotechnology, bioenergy and biobased products.

Conference Name: 7th International Brain Stimulation Conference
Venue: Lyon Convention Centre, 50 Quai Charles de Gaulle, 69006 Lyon, France
Program/Agenda: Four days of plenary lectures, symposia, poster sessions and industry workshops. For the 2027 meeting symposia are either one or two hours long and consist of three or six 15-minute presentations with a collective Q&A at the end. The poster abstract submission deadline is 28 August 2026, and submissions should be text of no more than 300 words. The deadline to submit a symposium is also 28 August 2026.
Technical/Program Committee: Conference Co-chairs: Charlotte Stagg (University of Oxford), Marom Bikson (City College of New York)

Conference Name: 5th Food Chemistry Conference
Program/Agenda: Held under the theme Fostering Cross-disciplinary Research to Advance Global Food Systems, bringing together journal editors, board members, authors, reviewers, academics, government agencies, R&D specialists, equipment and service suppliers and policymakers. The programme runs three oral topics in parallel sessions: Innovative Processing and Sustainable Valorisation; Nutrients, Bioactive Components and Other Emerging Components; and Methods and Technologies for Sustainability. The call for abstracts is closed.

Conference Name: EDUCAUSE Annual Conference 2027
Program/Agenda: Connects professionals and technology providers in higher education technology from around the world to network, share ideas, grow professionally and discover solutions to current challenges. Held in Orlando and online.

Conference Name: 15th NIZO Dairy Conference: Innovations in Milk Proteins
Venue: Papendal Hotel and Congress Centre, Arnhem, Netherlands
Program/Agenda: Covers technologies and developments around milk protein functionality, bringing together experts from dairy science and technology, processing, microbiology, chemistry, physics, sensory science, health and nutritional sciences. Oral and poster abstracts are invited through the online abstract submission system.

Conference Name: Latin America and Caribbean Region Student & Young Professional Leadership Summit 2026
Program/Agenda: A two-and-a-half day, invitation-only event providing professional and personal development for young leaders representing student and Young Professional chapters throughout the region, celebrating its 12th anniversary. Since 2013 the Summit has brought students from across Latin America and the Caribbean together for intensive professional and personal development sessions and training in leadership, communications, ethics and service. Since 2022 it has included Young Professionals representing AAPG's International Regions and United States Sections.

Conference Name: 5th Edition Stratigraphic Traps of the Middle East
Program/Agenda: Call for abstracts: the submission deadline is 14 August 2026. Poster abstracts should be sent directly to cnavarro@aapg.org.

Conference Name: 10th International Conference on Fracture of Polymers, Composites and Adhesives
Program/Agenda: Organised by the European Structural Integrity Society Technical Committee 4. The conference includes a special session to honour the contribution of the late Professor J. Gordon Williams to the understanding of fracture mechanics as applied to polymers and composites. The call for abstracts is open, with a deadline of 22 January 2027.

Conference Name: 2027 The 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation
Program/Agenda: Sponsored by Duy-Tan University, Da Nang. Call for papers: the submission deadline is 15 January 2027, notification 15 February 2027 and registration 5 March 2027. Each paper should be at least 4 full pages including figures and references; papers over 5 pages are subject to extra charges, with a maximum of 10 pages.

Conference Name: 2027 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Power and Integrated Energy Systems
Technical/Program Committee: Conference Committee: Junhua Zhao (The Chinese University of Hong Kong Shenzhen), Ping He (Zhengzhou University of Light Industry)

Program/Agenda: 14 June: participants onsite registration and conference materials collection. 15 June: keynote speeches, invited speeches and onsite sessions. 16 June: academic visit and one-day tour.
Sponsors/Exhibitors: Co-sponsor: Western Sydney University. Technical support: RMIT University

Conference Name: 2027 International Conference on Power Systems and Control Engineering
Program/Agenda: Sponsored by The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. The conference features keynote speeches, plenary sessions, panel discussions and technical paper presentations covering both theoretical advances and practical applications.
Sponsors/Exhibitors: Sponsor: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University

Conference Name: 2027 5th International Conference on Mechatronics and Electrical Engineering
Program/Agenda: Co-sponsored by the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and Shanghai University. 6 August: registration and on-site check in. 7 August: opening remarks and keynote speeches. 8 August: author presentations in sessions. The conference accepts full papers for publication and presentation and abstracts for presentation only; all submissions undergo a double-blind peer review evaluated on technical quality, relevance to scope, originality, significance and clarity.
Sponsors/Exhibitors: Co-sponsors: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Shanghai University

Conference Name: 2027 5th International Conference on Precision Engineering and Mechanical Manufacturing
Program/Agenda: 10 June: conference materials pick-up. 11 June: opening ceremony, keynote and invited speeches. Accepted and registered papers are published in the ICMIM Conference Proceedings as a special chapter, indexed by Scopus and Ei Compendex.

Conference Name: 2027 International Conference on Architecture and Environmental Research
Program/Agenda: The 13th International Conference on Advances in Environment Research. Accepted papers can be published in the International Journal of Environmental Science and Development, indexed by Scopus and Chemical Abstracts Services. The call for papers closes on 15 September 2026, with acceptance notifications on 5 October 2026.

Conference Name: 2027 7th International Conference on Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
Program/Agenda: Co-sponsored by Huaqiao University, hosted by the College of Computer Science and Technology of Huaqiao University and co-hosted by the Quanzhou Computer Society and Guangdong Polytechnic of Science and Technology. The programme covers Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Software Engineering Techniques and Production Perspectives, Software Engineering Methodologies, Software and System Quality of Service, and Software and System Security, with keynote speakers, presentations and interactive sessions.

Conference Name: 2027 5th International Forum on Clean Energy Engineering
Program/Agenda: 26 April: registration. 27 April: opening ceremony and keynote speeches from 09:00 to 10:15, followed by parallel oral sessions and further keynote speeches through the day. Call for papers: the submission deadline is 5 December 2026, with notification on 25 December 2026 and camera-ready papers by 10 January 2027. Selected papers are published in the E3S Web of Conferences proceedings, indexed by Scopus, CPCI (Web of Science), CAS, DOAJ, EBSCO and ProQuest.
Technical/Program Committee: Conference Chair: Tae-Jun Ha (Kwangwoon University). Technical Program Chairs: Yonghoon Kim, Hossam A. Gabbar, Xiao-Dong Zhou

Conference Name: 2027 14th International Conference on Management and Education Innovation
Program/Agenda: Organised by Regent's University London. A high-level interdisciplinary platform for researchers, educators, practitioners and industry leaders to exchange knowledge and explore emerging trends across management and education, welcoming theoretical research, empirical studies, technological developments and practical applications. Submitted papers are peer reviewed by the programme and technical committees, and accepted papers are published in the conference proceedings.

Conference Name: 2027 International Conference on System Safety and Security
Venue: Georgia Southern University, Savannah, Georgia, United States
Program/Agenda: An annual international academic conference fostering academic exchange and research-oriented collaboration in system safety and security, focusing on technological advances and engineering practices in the context of information technology, artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. All submissions undergo a double-blind peer review evaluated on technical quality, relevance to scope, originality, significance and clarity; accepted papers are published in the conference proceedings, indexed by EI Compendex and Scopus.

The symposium explores AI and machine learning for interpreting cellular states and context, and single-cell genomics for diagnostics and therapeutic discovery, alongside high-throughput multi-omics and perturbation technologies, lineage tracing and imaging. The early registration discount deadline is 25 September 2026.
